scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -i ./css/input.css -o ./css/utilities.css --minify && cat css/utilities.css css/site.components.css > css/site.css && cat css/a11y.css >> css/site.css
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:pages
scripts.bookings:migrate:test: wrangler d1 migrations apply nassau-bookings-test --remote --config workers/bookings/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.bookings:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply nassau-bookings-prod --remote --config workers/bookings/wrangler.prod.jsonc
